title: 90-Day Recovery + Growth Plan
note: Sequence protects existing demand first, then expands bilingual authority and conversion.

rows.Why now: Include every 200, canonical, indexable guide/location/company page; exclude redirects and 404s; submit split sitemaps.
rows.Definition of done: 60 of 92 GSC pages missing from sitemap · Target: 0 high-value GSC URLs missing

rows.Why now: Change title template so page titles contain the brand once; replace generic short descriptions.

rows.Why now: Deploy the workbook titles/descriptions on pages with ≥25 impressions and positions ≤15.

rows.Why now: Add legal name, address, map pin, registration, team, support hours and verified profiles after approval.

rows.Why now: Add contextual links from guide→commercial and commercial→trust/booking pages without repetitive anchors.
rows.Definition of done: Orphan and weak commercial paths · Target: Every priority URL ≥3 contextual inbound links

rows.Why now: Replace current short file and 410 llms-full with the exact content in this workbook.
rows.Definition of done: llms-full returns 410 · Target: Both files return 200 text/plain

rows.Why now: Track deploy dates, page groups, CTR, clicks, booking starts and completed bookings by locale.
